scope: Real production Chrome DOM/keyboard tests. Servo and Blink compiled via the unmodified browser Worker, which validates generated ELF and Intel HEX. No physical board attached; no physical upload tested. Separate full WASM library/example suites ran using the shipped compiler in Node transport.
